place._theme: An abandoned built site (20 POI types), so no residents stand where the camp should be: 'nobody is found' must be true at every draw.

prose.name: Survey: Faint Signal on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The comms office has picked up a faint signal from the <Place> and wants someone to go and find out what's sending it.
prose.card: Comms Office Contract. A faint signal is coming from the <Place> on <Planet>. Find its source. Payment on completion.

_note: PLAYER'S PART (2026-11-04, his ask, beats written on his 'sounds good, write the beats'): read a camp that is gone. The recorder first, then two things the camp left, found by looking in any order, then back to the recorder to switch it off: the ending is his hand on the switch. Nothing is explained, as Frances ruled.

FAINT SIGNAL: a new board family, his Trello card. Every letter has the SAME card, title and first journal, so the board never says which one he has drawn; what changes is what is at the source. The broadcast is the signal itself, heard on arrival.
⛔ FAMILY RULE: no letter's broadcast may hint at what the source is (card 20261031-080934): the survivor, the loop, the coffee and the bait must all sound like someone who wants to be found.

The source is a placed beacon (outpost beacon01, Overtime's own, on 7 recipes; Satellite_Beacon is ruled out on land). Voices borrowed until his ear casts them. No names, places or currency in any voiced line.
LETTER b: A LOOP: a camp's all-clear, sent every six hours for four years. Nobody is found and nothing is said about why.

FAMILY RULE, REFINED 2026-10-31 on the four verdicts: a broadcast may say what KIND of message it is (c's 'supply request', b's all-clear) but not what the source is; and a repeat player may recognise a letter by its call, which is answered by adding letters, not by blanking calls.

FRANCES 2026-10-31 (reviews/2026-10-31-delve-MB92b.md): ship, findings 1-3 taken, 4 kept as allowed. Forced pick answered NO: the broadcast offers no cause (the weather is cut), so the four years are explained by nothing a voice has said.
